name: usage
need: Show the tokens and the cost an assistant or agent used against a budget, with a word when it comes near or goes over

--ds-usage-gap.description: `.ds-usage`: the room between its parts, the base the density applies to (2px per step)

labExempt.DS.usage.shareOf: a pure function: the share of the budget, no motion
labExempt.DS.usage.stateOf: a pure function: near or over the budget, no motion
labExempt.DS.usage.usageText: a pure function: formatting, no motion
labExempt.DS.usage.costText: a pure function: formatting, no motion
